tags: @guarantee ok.initial the value starts at `initialValue`, 0 when it is not given
@guarantee ok.inc `inc` adds `delta` to the value, 1 when it is not given; `dec` subtracts it
@guarantee ok.bounds the value never goes above `max` or below `min`
@guarantee ok.set `set` sets the value to a number, or to what a function of the current value returns
@guarantee ok.reset `reset` sets the value back to `initialValue`
@guarantee ok.default the state starts at `defaultValue`, false when it is not given
@guarantee ok.toggle `toggle` switches the state between `defaultValue` and `reverseValue`
@guarantee ok.set `set` sets the state to the given value
@guarantee ok.left-right `setLeft` sets the state to `defaultValue`; `setRight` sets it to `reverseValue`, or to the reverse of `defaultValue` when `reverseValue` is not given
@guarantee ok.default the state starts at `defaultValue`, false when it is not given
@guarantee ok.actions `toggle` switches the state, `set` sets it to the given value, `setTrue` to true and `setFalse` to false
